text_block_list.text: Beep, beep, beЭпизод.. BeЭпизод..
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
All righty! Starting today, my life as a
Tracen Academy student finally
begins!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right! If it's okay with you,
Suzuka, do you want to go to
school
toge—
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: She's already gone?!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Her tracksuit's not here, so maybe she
went for an early morning run?
Wow, she
really wakes up early...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
I wonder if she'd let me run with her again
if I asked.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Maybe when she gets back, I'll work up
the courage to ask. Then
afterwards... Hee
hee!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Ah! I gotta get going! If I keep
daydreaming, I'm gonna be late!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Bueno!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Hello, greetings, and salutations! I've been
waiting for our bold new
challenger to
step into the ring! Bienvenida, Special
Week!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Huh, ah, huh?!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Oh... Do excuse her for startling you. I'll be
sure to give her a stern
talking to
afterwards.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: My lecture senses are tingling!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I'm Грасс Вандер, and this is El Condor
Pasa. It's a pleasure to meet
you, Special
Week.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah, nice to meet you too! So... is it
okay if I call you Grass and El
then?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Sí! Oh, and if ya feel like it, I wouldn't
mind ya taggin' "the world's
strongest
racer" to my name either!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Anda! Class is about to start! Hasta luego,
Spe! See ya later!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Y-yeah, see you!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
(Did I just make some friends? Yeees! I
should keep this up for class
and training
too!)
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
All right, then, Спешл Уик, please
answer number five... Special
Week? Hey,
are you listening?
text_block_list.name: Teacher A

text_block_list.text:
Y-yes?! S-sorry, I was copying notes from
the board!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
(So fast! Back home, the teacher always
met my pace since I was the
only student. I
didn't think classes in the big city'd be
goin' a mile a
minute!)
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
This is bad, bad, bad, Spe! There's gonna
be a quiz in math class
next!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Wh-what?! A quiz?! Wh-wh-what should I
do? I'm not ready at all!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
It's times like these where one must remain
calm, Spe. The contents of
the test will all
be fundamentals, so you'll be fine.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Grass... Oh, thank you so much! That's
right, if it's the basics then it'll
be okay!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: (Or at least that's what I'd say if I knew the basics!)
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Спешл Уик... Now, I know you're our
new transfer, but this score
is... I think I'll
have to assign you some extra work.
text_block_list.name: Teacher A (Man)

text_block_list.text: I'm sooooorry!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Sigh...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Don't think too much about it, Spe. It's
still your first day, it's normal
not to have a
solid grip on things yet.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, she's right! There's no use in feelin'
down! In any case, this
afternoon is...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
The highly anticipated! The long-awaited!
The moment we've all been
waiting for...
Practice tiiiiime! We'll be training our
racing skills!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Training! Yeah... You're totally right! So
what if class went bad?
Surely training will
go much better!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Oh my. It seems Spe will be in this group
for the scrimmage.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
No way! Now I'm feelin' extra pumped! I
heard her results in the
entrance exam
were super amazing!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm also looking forward to it. I
wonder what kind of running style
she has.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Ka-thunk!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huff... puff... Huff... puff...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Hmm, she's a little behind the middle.
Think that makes her a late
surger?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: She seems somewhat... stiff.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
(There are four furlongs to go! I'd better
kick it into high gear here!)
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Haaah—hm! Huh?!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
(Wh-what?! No way, why are my legs so
heavy?! I-I shouldn't be tired
yet!)
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Guess she ran out of gas...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Hm... She's likely not used to this track...
Then there are also nerves
to consider...
Those combined might already have her
drained.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Hmm... So that's why her running feels off.
Qué pena...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Sigh... First class and now training too? Everything's gone so horribly...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Now, now, Spe. Remember, it's still your
first day. I think it's best if
you take your
time getting used to everything.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Graaaaass! You still haven't changed yet?!
Don't tell me you've
forgotten your
promise, your sworn oath!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Calm down. If it's our partner running
you're referring to, then, no, I
haven't.
You'll have to excuse us, Spe. We'll see
you tomorrow.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Oh... Y-yes, see you tomorrow!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Both of them are so amazing. Classes
during the morning and training
in the
afternoon. Then more training after all
that.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
(I wonder if I'll be able to keep up...
Mom...)
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик
